```{ojs}
//| echo: false
shotsData    = FileAttachment("data/shots.json").json()
playerNames  = Object.keys(shotsData.players).sort()
allPlayers   = shotsData.all_players
correlation  = shotsData.correlation
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selectedPlayer = Inputs.select(playerNames, {
  label: "Player",
  value: playerNames.includes("Aldrich Potgieter") ? "Aldrich Potgieter" : playerNames[0]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
playerData = shotsData.players[selectedPlayer]

xScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-80, 80]).range([60, 540])
yScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-20, 360]).range([540, 60])

sessionColor = {
  const sessions = [...new Set(playerData.shots.map(d => d.sess))];
  return d3.scaleOrdinal().domain(sessions).range(d3.schemeTableau10);
}

clusterColor = (c) => c === 0 ? "#cccccc" : d3.schemeTableau10[(c - 1) % 10]
```

## Reading a player's range session

Every shot a tour player hits on the range is tracked. The launch monitor records the full flight — every fraction of a second of position, all the way to landing. That's a lot of data per shot, and a typical session has 50–150 shots. To say anything useful about a player we need to compress that down. Here's how.

Pick a player above and scroll.

::::{.cr-section}

Each line is one shot, viewed from above. The tee is the black dot at the bottom; the player aims roughly up the page. You can already see how the player worked the ball — left and right, short and long. @cr-shotsviz

But for what we want to do, the full trajectory is overkill. We only really care about *where each ball ended up*. So we collapse each shot down to a single point: its landing position. @cr-shotsviz

These dots aren't all from one go. A player splits their range time across multiple sessions and bays — different days, different warm-ups, different intent. Each colour is one session. @cr-shotsviz

Within a session, players hit groups of shots at the same target. We can find these groups automatically with DBSCAN — a clustering algorithm that picks out dense groupings and labels everything else as noise. Each colour now is a cluster of shots aimed at one target. The grey points are noise. @cr-shotsviz

The noise points aren't useful for analysing dispersion — they're transitions between targets, mishits, or one-offs. Drop them. @cr-shotsviz

Now the real trick. Each cluster is aimed at a different target, so comparing them directly is meaningless. We rotate every cluster so its centre lies on the same vertical line — straight up the page. Now every shot's lateral deviation is measured against its own intended target. @cr-shotsviz

With every shot referenced to a common axis, we can ask: how big is this player's overall dispersion? One answer is the convex hull — the smallest polygon containing (almost) all of their normalised landing points. @cr-shotsviz

From the hull we extract two summary numbers: its **area** and its **length** — the range of carry distances covered. Their ratio is an "average width" measured in yards: how far sideways the player tends to miss, per yard of carry. One number for an entire session. @cr-shotsviz

Compute that number for every player in the field and plot it against their tournament finish. The relationship is real but loose — there's a positive correlation (Spearman ρ shown top-right), but plenty of players win with sloppy ranges and lose with tidy ones. Range tightness is one input among many. @cr-shotsviz

:::{#cr-shotsviz}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
shotsViz = {
  const width = 600, height = 600;
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
    .style("max-width", "100%")
    .style("height", "auto")
    .style("background", "#ffffff");

  // Reference axes
  svg.append("line").attr("class", "ref-line")
    .attr("x1", xScale(-80)).attr("x2", xScale(80))
    .attr("y1", yScale(0)).attr("y2", yScale(0))
    .attr("stroke", "#ddd").attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
  svg.append("line").attr("class", "ref-line")
    .attr("x1", xScale(0)).attr("x2", xScale(0))
    .attr("y1", yScale(-20)).attr("y2", yScale(360))
    .attr("stroke", "#ddd").attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");

  // Tee
  svg.append("circle").attr("class", "tee")
    .attr("cx", xScale(0)).attr("cy", yScale(0))
    .attr("r", 4).attr("fill", "black");

  const lineGen = d3.line().x(d => xScale(d[0])).y(d => yScale(d[1]));

  // Trajectories
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "trajectories")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(playerData.shots.filter(d => d.traj))
    .join("path")
      .attr("class", "trajectory")
      .attr("d", d => lineGen(d.traj))
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1)
      .attr("opacity", 0.4);

  // Shot circles
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "shots")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(playerData.shots)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("class", "shot")
      .attr("cx", d => xScale(d.land_x))
      .attr("cy", d => yScale(d.land_z))
      .attr("r", 3)
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .attr("opacity", 0);

  // Hull + annotations
  if (playerData.hull && playerData.hull.length > 2) {
    svg.append("path").attr("class", "hull")
      .attr("d", lineGen(playerData.hull) + "Z")
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0)
      .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
      .attr("stroke-opacity", 0)
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5);

    // Geometry for annotations
    const cx    = d3.mean(playerData.hull, d => d[0]);
    const cz    = d3.mean(playerData.hull, d => d[1]);
    const minZ  = d3.min(playerData.hull,  d => d[1]);
    const maxZ  = d3.max(playerData.hull,  d => d[1]);
    const maxX  = d3.max(playerData.hull,  d => d[0]);

    // Area label inside hull
    svg.append("text").attr("class", "anno area-label")
      .attr("x", xScale(cx)).attr("y", yScale(cz))
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("dominant-baseline", "central")
      .attr("font-size", 13).attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .attr("fill", "#1a4a7a").attr("opacity", 0)
      .text(`Area = ${playerData.hull_area} yd²`);

    // Length bracket on right side of hull
    const bx = xScale(maxX) + 14;
    const tickW = 6;
    const lengthGroup = svg.append("g").attr("class", "anno length-group").attr("opacity", 0);
    lengthGroup.append("line")
      .attr("x1", bx).attr("x2", bx)
      .attr("y1", yScale(minZ)).attr("y2", yScale(maxZ))
      .attr("stroke", "#1a4a7a").attr("stroke-width", 1.5);
    lengthGroup.append("line")
      .attr("x1", bx - tickW).attr("x2", bx + tickW)
      .attr("y1", yScale(minZ)).attr("y2", yScale(minZ))
      .attr("stroke", "#1a4a7a").attr("stroke-width", 1.5);
    lengthGroup.append("line")
      .attr("x1", bx - tickW).attr("x2", bx + tickW)
      .attr("y1", yScale(maxZ)).attr("y2", yScale(maxZ))
      .attr("stroke", "#1a4a7a").attr("stroke-width", 1.5);
    lengthGroup.append("text")
      .attr("x", bx + 10).attr("y", yScale((minZ + maxZ) / 2))
      .attr("text-anchor", "start")
      .attr("dominant-baseline", "central")
      .attr("font-size", 13).attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .attr("fill", "#1a4a7a")
      .text(`Length = ${playerData.hull_length} yd`);
  }

  // Big metric text
  svg.append("text").attr("class", "metric-text")
    .attr("x", 300).attr("y", 565)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", 22).attr("font-weight", "bold")
    .attr("fill", "#1a4a7a").attr("opacity", 0)
    .text(`Dispersion metric = ${playerData.dispersion_metric}`);

  // ---- Scatter group (stage 8) ----
  const maxRank   = d3.max(allPlayers, d => d.rank);
  const maxMetric = d3.max(allPlayers, d => d.dispersion_metric) * 1.1;
  const rankScale   = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, maxRank * 1.05]).range([80, 540]);
  const metricScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, maxMetric]).range([520, 80]);

  const scatter = svg.append("g").attr("class", "scatter").attr("opacity", 0);

  // Axes
  scatter.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(0, ${metricScale(0)})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(rankScale).ticks(6))
    .selectAll("text").attr("font-size", 11);
  scatter.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(${rankScale(0)}, 0)`)
    .call(d3.axisLeft(metricScale).ticks(6))
    .selectAll("text").attr("font-size", 11);

  // Axis labels
  scatter.append("text")
    .attr("x", (rankScale(0) + rankScale(maxRank)) / 2).attr("y", 565)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 12)
    .text("Tournament rank →");
  scatter.append("text")
    .attr("transform", "rotate(-90)")
    .attr("x", -300).attr("y", 30)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 12)
    .text("Dispersion metric");

  // Regression line (clipped to plot area)
  const slope     = correlation.linear_slope;
  const intercept = correlation.linear_intercept;
  const yAt = r => intercept + slope * r;
  scatter.append("line").attr("class", "regression")
    .attr("x1", rankScale(0))
    .attr("y1", metricScale(yAt(0)))
    .attr("x2", rankScale(maxRank))
    .attr("y2", metricScale(yAt(maxRank)))
    .attr("stroke", "#e74c3c").attr("stroke-width", 2)
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", "5,3").attr("opacity", 0.8);

  // All-player dots
  scatter.selectAll("circle.player-dot")
    .data(allPlayers)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("class", "player-dot")
      .attr("cx", d => rankScale(d.rank))
      .attr("cy", d => metricScale(d.dispersion_metric))
      .attr("r",  d => d.name === selectedPlayer ? 7 : 3)
      .attr("fill", d => d.name === selectedPlayer ? "steelblue" : "#bbb")
      .attr("stroke", d => d.name === selectedPlayer ? "white" : "none")
      .attr("stroke-width", 2)
      .attr("opacity", d => d.name === selectedPlayer ? 1 : 0.6)
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
      .append("title")
        .text(d => `${d.name}\nRank: ${d.rank}\nDispersion: ${d.dispersion_metric}`);

  // Selected player label
  const sel = allPlayers.find(d => d.name === selectedPlayer);
  if (sel) {
    scatter.append("text")
      .attr("x", rankScale(sel.rank))
      .attr("y", metricScale(sel.dispersion_metric) - 14)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size", 12).attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
      .text(selectedPlayer);
  }

  // Correlation labels (top-right)
  scatter.append("text")
    .attr("x", 530).attr("y", 100).attr("text-anchor", "end")
    .attr("font-size", 11).attr("fill", "#444")
    .text(`Spearman ρ = ${correlation.spearman}`);
  scatter.append("text")
    .attr("x", 530).attr("y", 116).attr("text-anchor", "end")
    .attr("font-size", 11).attr("fill", "#444")
    .text(`Kendall τ = ${correlation.kendall}`);

  return svg.node();
}
```
:::

::::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
animate = {
  const stage = crTriggerIndex;
  const sel   = d3.select(shotsViz);
  const dur   = 700;

  // Reference axes & tee — fade out for scatter view
  sel.selectAll(".ref-line, .tee")
    .transition("refs").duration(dur)
    .attr("opacity", stage >= 8 ? 0 : 1);

  // Trajectories
  sel.selectAll(".trajectory")
    .transition("traj").duration(dur)
    .attr("opacity", stage === 0 ? 0.4 : 0);

  // Shot positions
  sel.selectAll(".shot")
    .transition("pos").duration(dur)
    .attr("cx", d => xScale(stage >= 5 && d.norm_x != null ? d.norm_x : d.land_x))
    .attr("cy", d => yScale(stage >= 5 && d.norm_z != null ? d.norm_z : d.land_z));

  // Shot opacity & colour
  sel.selectAll(".shot")
    .transition("style").duration(dur)
    .attr("opacity", d => {
      if (stage === 0) return 0;
      if (stage >= 8) return 0;
      if (stage >= 4 && d.cluster === 0) return 0;
      if (stage === 3) return d.cluster === 0 ? 0.25 : 0.7;
      return 0.7;
    })
    .attr("fill", d => {
      if (stage === 2) return sessionColor(d.sess);
      if (stage >= 3) return clusterColor(d.cluster);
      return "steelblue";
    });

  // Hull
  sel.select(".hull")
    .transition("hull").duration(dur)
    .attr("fill-opacity",  (stage === 6 || stage === 7) ? 0.2 : 0)
    .attr("stroke-opacity",(stage === 6 || stage === 7) ? 1   : 0);

  // Annotations: staggered reveal at stage 7 — area first, then length, then metric.
  // On exit (any other stage) they all fade together with no delay.
  const showAnno = stage === 7;
  sel.select(".area-label")
    .transition("anno-area").duration(dur)
    .delay(showAnno ? 0 : 0)
    .attr("opacity", showAnno ? 1 : 0);
  sel.select(".length-group")
    .transition("anno-len").duration(dur)
    .delay(showAnno ? 250 : 0)
    .attr("opacity", showAnno ? 1 : 0);
  sel.select(".metric-text")
    .transition("anno-metric").duration(dur)
    .delay(showAnno ? 500 : 0)
    .attr("opacity", showAnno ? 1 : 0);

  // Scatter
  sel.select(".scatter")
    .transition("scatter").duration(dur)
    .attr("opacity", stage === 8 ? 1 : 0);

  return stage;
}
```

## What's next

The metric we just built is one signal among many. Driving accuracy off the tee, putting, course management — they all matter. But for a single-number summary of a tour player's range work, this is a defensible answer: how wide their landing dispersion gets, scaled by how far they're hitting it.
